Hospitality

Manage tables, rooms, kitchens, and bars from one system. POS, inventory, recipes, and accounting — connected from order to ledger.

Your challenges

Table and room management

Tracking which tables are occupied, which rooms are available, and what has been ordered requires constant coordination between front-of-house and back-of-house.

Perishable inventory

Food and beverage inventory is perishable. Without batch tracking and expiry management, waste is high and true cost is unknown.

Recipe costing

You serve dishes but do not know the actual cost per plate — ingredients, portion sizes, and waste are not tracked systematically.

End-of-day reconciliation

Cash, mobile money, and card payments across multiple outlets (restaurant, bar, rooms) must be reconciled daily. Manual reconciliation is slow and error-prone.

How Kraal Code helps

POS with Table Mode

Table-based ordering for restaurants and bars. Open tables, add items, transfer between tables, split bills, and close bills. Kitchen order printing.

Recipe Management

Define recipes with ingredients, portions, and expected cost per serving. Track actual vs planned consumption. Identify dishes with poor margins.

Perishable Inventory

Track food and beverage stock with batch numbers and expiry dates. FEFO picking ensures older stock is used first. Waste tracking and reporting.

Multi-Outlet Management

Manage restaurant, bar, room service, and shop from one system. Consolidated reporting. Separate cash sessions per outlet.

Shift Management

Track staff shifts and attendance. Link staff to POS transactions for accountability. Generate shift reports.

Financial Integration

Every sale posts to inventory and accounting automatically. End-of-day Z-reports. Monthly P&L by outlet. No manual journal entries for daily sales.
